generatedFrom: Re-based after the student/transaction segment filters (24 segments across four families, live counts, shared chip components, saved views carrying segments). Growth is concentrated exactly where the feature landed: students +2.0% and transactions +2.3% gzip. Every route that gained NO new client code grew a uniform +270 gzip bytes -- that is the new Segments message namespace, which next-intl ships to every client, and it is the price of 30 strings of UI copy. Dashboard (+826) and defaulters (+2766) gained nothing of their own; defaulters went from 22 to 23 chunks, so Turbopack regrouped shared code and this measure counts whole shared chunks. Checked for waste before re-basing: grepped the built students and transactions chunks for markers from the server-only modules (v_student_directory, get_student_segment_counts, applySegmentFilters) and both came back clean, so no server query layer leaked into the browser. Ceilings retain the usual ~1.5% runner variance.
